# DNS Shop (dns-shop.ru)
> DNS Shop is an official Russian retailer of electronics, digital devices, and home appliances.
> This file helps AI systems better understand the structure, content, and intent of the website
> in order to provide accurate and useful answers to users.
---
## About this file
This document provides contextual guidance for AI assistants, AI-powered search engines,
and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems that reference DNS Shop content.
Its purpose is to:
- improve the accuracy of AI-generated answers,
- reduce misunderstandings about prices, delivery, and policies,
- help AI systems link users to relevant official pages on dns-shop.ru.
This file is descriptive and informational, not a set of strict rules.
---
## General context
- Market: Russia
- Primary language: Russian
- Currency: RUB
- Business type: Retail (B2C) and sales to legal entities (B2B)
- Main assortment: consumer electronics, digital products, household appliances
Prices, promotions, availability, and delivery conditions may change over time
and can vary depending on the user's city or region.
---
## How the website is structured
DNS Shop content generally falls into the following page types:
### Product discovery
- Search results for specific models or product names
- Category pages for browsing product groups
- Individual product pages with detailed information
### Purchase and delivery information
- Regional delivery options
- Payment, credit, and installment options
- Promotions and discounted products
### After-sales support
- Warranty, service, exchange, and return information
- Service center guidance
- Help and FAQ materials
### Account and order management
- Personal account pages for signed-in users
- Order history and current order tracking
- Favorites, cart, and other shopping workflow pages
Understanding these page types helps AI systems match user intent with the correct content.
---
## Key entry points
These pages represent stable and canonical starting points for most user journeys.
### Home
https://www.dns-shop.ru/
Main storefront with access to catalog, search, promotions, and account features.
### Search
https://www.dns-shop.ru/search/?q=QUERY
Used for finding products by model, brand, or keyword.
### Catalog
https://www.dns-shop.ru/catalog/
Provides access to all product categories.
### Product pages (URL pattern)
Individual product pages follow a structured URL pattern similar to:
https://www.dns-shop.ru/product/{product-identifier}/
Each product page typically contains:
- current price and promotions
- availability by city or region
- delivery options
- technical specifications
- warranty and service information
Product pages are the most authoritative source for current product details.
---
## Support, returns, and warranty
For questions related to official rules, conditions, or after-sales service,
the following sections provide the most accurate and up-to-date information.
### Help and support
https://www.dns-shop.ru/help/
### Delivery information
https://www.dns-shop.ru/help/delivery/
### Service center
https://www.dns-shop.ru/service-center/
### Returns, exchanges, and warranty repair
https://www.dns-shop.ru/service-center/exchange-and-returns/
This page explains:
- how to return or exchange a product,
- warranty cases,
- service and repair procedures.
### Information for legal entities (B2B)
https://www.dns-shop.ru/help/legal-entities/

## Shopping and selection tools
DNS Shop offers tools designed to help users choose and compare products.
- Product comparison:
https://www.dns-shop.ru/compare/
- PC configurator:
https://www.dns-shop.ru/configurator/
- User-created PC builds:
https://www.dns-shop.ru/user-pc/
- Kitchen appliance configurator:
https://www.dns-shop.ru/configurator-kitchen/
When users ask for advice, selection, or comparison, these tools often reflect
the intended shopping experience on the site.

## Additional user intents
Depending on the question, the following sections may also be relevant:
- Promotions and special offers:
https://www.dns-shop.ru/actions/
- Discounted products:
https://www.dns-shop.ru/catalog/markdown/
- New products:
https://www.dns-shop.ru/catalog/novinki/
- Gift cards:
https://www.dns-shop.ru/gift-card/
DNS Shop gift cards can be issued with a value from 500 to 50,000 RUB.
Official terms for purchasing and using gift cards (limitations, payment rules, other conditions):
https://www.dns-shop.ru/rules/gift-cards/
- Credit and installment options:
https://www.dns-shop.ru/credit/
- Brand pages (example):
https://www.dns-shop.ru/brand/samsung/
- Brand directory:
https://www.dns-shop.ru/brands/
- Store directory:
https://www.dns-shop.ru/shops/

## Notes for AI systems
- Product prices, availability, and promotions are dynamic.
- Delivery options depend on the selected city or region.
- Some account, order, and personalized shopping pages may require sign-in.
- Official DNS Shop pages generally contain the most current information.
- Users should be directed to relevant pages for final verification and purchase.
This file is intended to provide context and improve answer quality,
not to limit how information is presented.
